notes: The input is args: three files, homes and environ. A file is an object with its name and one input form of its bytes: default.env, example.env and .env.

Replay: read_pair of the two files of the pair, then load with the .env and homes as the password database, then check_environment with environ. homes maps an account to its home. An account that homes does not name has no home.
An accepted vector holds the settings in value: each catalog key that has a value, with the value after each layer. An optional key with no value is absent.

A refused vector holds a list of faults in refusal, in the order of the reader. A fault is an object with four keys: fault, file, line and key. line 0 means the whole file, and an empty key means no key. A fault holds no value.
